integrity: A complete general combinatorial proof and independently constructed finite rank/angle checks are included. No claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Canonical unscaled Euclidean standard order polytopes of finite posets with at least two elements; not chain or general marked polytopes. Classical compatible face partitions and facet correspondence credited. Priority is provisional because an equivalent unindexed or implicit prior formula may exist. Finite enumeration complements, rather than replaces, the proof.
title: Four-angle ridge spectra and crossed-cover obstructions for all Euclidean order polytopes
